aria: Animated recap of the Rockets' 115 to 108 home win over Golden State: Reed Sheppard's 3-pointer with 8 minutes 43 seconds left that made it 96 to 85, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Alperen Şengün's 19 points, 13 rebounds and 9 assists, the top scorers, how the Rockets won, and the next game at home against Utah.
notes: Box score from the Rockets' 115–108 home win over the Golden State Warriors on Nov 11, 2026, from the Covers.com box score, with game details from the AP (Kristie Rieken, via TSN), Field Level Media, Golden State of Mind (SB Nation, via Yahoo Sports) and the CBS Sports play-by-play. All 115 Rockets points and all 108 Warriors points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores add up to both totals (56–51 at the half on Şengün's putback with 0.4 seconds left; Field Level Media). Biggest lead: Houston's 18; Golden State never led (Covers.com), though it tied the game at 51 late in the second quarter (Golden State of Mind). Team stats are from Covers.com; Field Level Media also has Houston ahead 50–34 in the paint, and 6 of 10 from three in the fourth quarter. Records and conference ranks are from the site's standings (data/season.json) after Wednesday's games: Houston 9–3 (third in the west), Utah 1–11.

The loss ended Golden State's eight-game winning streak, its longest since 2022 (AP). Stephen Curry left in the first quarter with right abdominal soreness after scoring 3 points and did not return (AP; Field Level Media calls it a right abdominal strain). Marcus Smart was ejected late in the third quarter after a flagrant 2 foul on Charles Bassey (AP; CBS Sports play-by-play). Houston hosts Utah on Friday at 8:30 PM ET (AP; Sportbusy schedule).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Reed Sheppard's 3-pointer with 8:43 left in the fourth quarter, assisted by Şengün, his second straight three, which made it 96–85 after Golden State had cut a 15-point deficit to 88–85 (AP; Field Level Media; CBS Sports play-by-play). The recaps don't describe how he got the shot, so it is drawn as the template's plain pull-up. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Houston Rockets or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Sheppard’s listed 6-foot-2 and 185 pounds (RealGM), with arms scaled to his 6-foot-3¼ wingspan at the 2024 draft combine (Bleacher Report), in the Rockets' home kit. His No. 15 is from RealGM. His look isn't on file yet, so he is drawn as a team-colour silhouette. It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
